abilities.name: name
abilities.function: Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent name sign where you stand that nearby people can see. No physical effect.

abilities.name: mark
abilities.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

abilities.name: tell
abilities.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

abilities.name: invite
abilities.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

satisfaction.rationale: Separate offer and acceptance around an actual finding; no relation or physical agreement is invented.

reviews.reason: The related-capability searches and exact probe/gather records do not establish an equivalent cultivation function. probe can observe or perform small press/wet/heat tests; gather only transfers existing stock. Neither plants propagules nor maintains a living crop. Develop a general plant-cultivation operation in the current-conversation handoff, with an executable planting trial as the minimum version. Edibility and mature root stock do not establish that harvested roots can reproduce. No viable propagule, renewable yield or successful propagation is granted by this review. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Three personal study rounds are required; review and implementation waiting do not advance them or the world. Study, requests, naming, registration and obtaining the capability award no pleasure, satisfaction or mastery reward. Real planting/tending may support modest personally applicable practice benefit, and a verified observation—including an informative failure—may support information-gain benefit. Enforce in code: at most 0.2 short pleasure per completed, applicable event, total cultivation pleasure capped at 0.5 per actor in a rolling 10-round window; duplicate observations of unchanged facts yield zero. Short pleasure expires over at most five elapsed rounds. Maintained cultivation satisfaction accrues only from actual useful care or verified learning, at most 0.01 per qualifying round to a cultivation contribution cap of 0.2, decaying by 0.002 per elapsed round without qualifying activity. Deduplicate the same functional event against probe, gathering and other practice rewards; familiar useful care need not be novel. Inconclusive repeated checks, failed placement and merely scheduled work do not qualify. No benefit overrides hunger, nutrition, health or permissions; no physical-comfort increase is inherent here, and any independently justified comfort remains globally capped at 10. Never alter protected reward accounts, budgets or goals.
reviews.visualReview: Use reusable cultivation metadata: bed ID, position, footprint, substrate appearance, input resource, count, observed stage, condition, work progress and last actual observation. Emit observable events for completed soil preparation/placement, actual tending, observed emergence, maturation, harvest, wilting and death only when those changes occur. Proposed reusable stages are prepared, planted-unverified, rooted-observed, growing, harvestable, stressed and dead; unknown stages remain unknown. A planting trial shows disturbed soil and only physically exposed material, not invented leaves. Progress indicators describe completed labor or measured biological progress, never guaranteed viability or countdown-to-success without a validated recipe. Failed or interrupted actions show the actual partial work and failure reason, not a completed green crop. Hidden viability and resource pools must not leak through colors, labels or event metadata. Visuals and cosmetic labels alone confer neither functional growth nor experience.
reviews.specification:
General operation: Cultivate plants, parameterized by mode (inspect, plant, tend, inspect-progress, abandon), target plant/bed, actual material reference, positive integer quantity and accessible soil location. Any applicable actor may learn it; do not bind it to Wren or meadow roots. Reuse and record existing reference resolution, inventory transactions, action-progress, spatial and plant handlers rather than claim them as new inventions. Exact available dependencies: probe/open.probe, open-baseline:probe:1, foundation-open@1; gather/forest.gather, base:gather:1, foundation-forest@1. Navigation and harvesting remain separate actions with their existing costs. No new irrigation, tool manufacture or water inventory is implied.
Applicability and references: resolve owned input stacks and nearby soil using their actual identities and revisions; validate ownership, quantity, accessibility and competing reservations on execution. Wren's possible input is item-4-wren-47, currently four root units, not a free four-unit planting allowance. start-0-roots is an existing mature source with stock 1 and capacity 6, not evidence of a propagation recipe or automatic replenishment. Neither that stock nor the observed commons stocks may be silently transferred, multiplied or relabeled as seedlings. Wren's recorded nutrition 14/toxicity 0 establishes food properties only. The reported moisture 0.65 is not proof of crop suitability. Inspect locally before assigning bed moisture or other environmental properties. Do not expose unseen resource stocks, hidden biological flags or inaccessible locations.
Minimum executable version: an empirical intact-propagule planting trial in ordinary accessible, hand-workable soil. Inspection takes one active round and 0.2 energy, using the existing probe observation path where applicable; it reports observable integrity, shoots or buds only when actually visible, never guaranteed viability. Planting requires one whole owned root or another physically supported propagule per trial position; no cutting multiplication. With an intact root whose viability is unknown, allow an explicitly uncertain trial rather than rejecting cultivation outright. If material is demonstrably unsuitable, explain the observed reason without consuming it. Digging and placing one unit takes two active rounds at 1 energy per round; no tool is required only when the actual soil is shallow, loose and safely hand-workable. Hard, obstructed or hazardous ground fails that prerequisite without inventing tools. Each additional unit requires its own space, input and full work cost. Planting transfers the whole input from food inventory to an identifiable planted-material record, retaining its measured quantity, origin and condition; it produces a real occupied soil site, not an immediately harvestable food source. Do not automatically spend all four roots.
Growth mechanism: development must resolve the actual meadow plant's supported propagation biology and implement a species/material recipe in code before enabling successful reproduction. A recipe must specify viable input structures, environmental ranges, rooting and maturity durations, survival/decay rules, harvestable mass, retained living structure, regeneration interval and finite carrying capacity. Those facts are not supplied here: do not assume every edible root sprouts, use the source's capacity as a yield recipe, invent seeds, or promise a fixed successful growth date. The executable trial remains available if suitability is unresolved. It has an initial 20 elapsed-world-round observation window, with optional inspections at rounds 5, 10 and 20; this is a trial schedule, not a claim that the species roots or matures in 20 rounds. Each inspection costs one active round and 0.2 energy and reports only actual changes. No visible change is recorded as inconclusive, not success or proof of nonviability. If no grounded biological growth rule exists yet, the trial can produce a planted bed and real observations but cannot generate shoots, roots or renewable food by a random success roll. Resolve missing biological mechanisms in this development handoff rather than permanently rejecting them or requiring an unrelated unlock.
Ongoing execution: planted material ages and experiences actual soil, weather, competition and decay as simulation time passes; global development/review waiting advances none of these clocks. A validated recipe advances growth only for elapsed qualifying time and debits real local water/nutrient pools while recording light-driven biomass production and losses. No positive harvest without that production ledger. Existing inventory decay is not silently reset by planting; implement the justified living-versus-harvested state transition. Unrooted material can rot or die. A rooted living plant can persist without an actor continuously working, but tending does not replace water or suitable conditions. Manual tending costs one active round and 0.5 energy per planted position for actual inspection and physical removal of accessible competing growth, if any; it creates no water, fertilizer or blanket growth bonus. If watering later becomes necessary it requires a separately implemented transfer of actual accessible water with explicit quantity and costs, not imaginary watering.
Products and renewal: only a genuinely mature plant may expose recipe-accounted edible stock for gather; gather then costs its existing 2 energy per unit and decreases that stock. Return the existing root nutrition/toxicity only if the product is in fact that resource. Reserving a living crown or suitable propagule for renewal removes it from edible yield. Complete destructive harvest ends that plant's renewal. Regrowth must consume real elapsed time and environmental inputs under the validated recipe; bed capacity limits storage and occupancy, not free replenishment. No mature stock appears from learning, labeling a bed, waiting for review or completing planting work.
Progress and lifecycle: persist actor, resolved references, reserved quantity, bed position, completed work, spent energy, biological stage and timestamps. Reserve one unconsumed input for a planting action; transfer it into the bed exactly once at completed placement. Interruption preserves completed work and spent costs; resume revalidates access, living state and remaining prerequisites. Cancel before placement releases only surviving unconsumed reserved material once, without refunding energy or elapsed time. Cancel or abandon after placement leaves the real bed and planted material in place; it does not refund edible roots. Retrieving planted material, if supported later, must be an actual physical operation returning its then-current condition, never the original undamaged input automatically. Death terminates the actor's labor, releases surviving unplaced reservations to the estate under ordinary item rules and leaves placed plants to their environmental processes. No automatic inheritance of mastery or assignment of caretakers. Other participants must independently choose, communicate and perform any work. All resource transactions and interruption rules execute in code, with idempotent event IDs and no repeated model adjudication.
